title: Benjamini-Schramm conjecture p_c<p_u for non-amenable Cayley graphs
exact_target: Does a Cayley graph have a nonempty percolation phase with multiple infinite clusters exactly when its group is nonamenable?

sources.citation: H. Duminil-Copin, "Sixty years of percolation", Proc. International Congress of Mathematicians 2018, vol. IV, pp. 639-672; arXiv:1712.04651.
